definitions.explanation: A room designated for private use, as opposed to a shared or open space. Common in restaurants, hospitals, hotels, and other facilities.

examples.japanese: {個室|こしつ}を{予約|よやく}する。
この{居酒屋|いざかや}には{個室|こしつ}がある。
{入院|にゅういん}するなら{大部屋|おおべや}より{個室|こしつ}のほうが{落|お}ち{着|つ}く。
examples.english: If I'm hospitalized, I'd feel more at ease in a private room than a shared ward.

notes:
In Japanese restaurants, {個室|こしつ} are popular for business dinners, dates, and group gatherings where privacy is desired. In hospitals, {個室|こしつ} typically cost more than shared wards ({大部屋|おおべや}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{個室|こしつ}を{予約|よやく}する (reserve a private room)
・{完全|かんぜん}{個室|こしつ} (fully private room)
・{個室|こしつ}{料金|りょうきん} (private room charge)
・{個室|こしつ}ダイニング (private dining room)
